definitions.gloss: tumult; hustle and bustle; noise; clamor
definitions.explanation: Loud, chaotic noise or commotion, especially associated with crowded places or busy environments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{喧騒|けんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
examples.english: To get away from the hustle and bustle of the city.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}めて→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{喧騒|けんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: Even with the window closed, I can hear the noise outside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{喧騒|けんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧きた。
examples.english: The clamor of the festival ended, and a quiet night returned.

notes:
{喧騒|けんそう} refers to the loud, chaotic noise of busy places — not just volume, but the lively commotion of crowds, traffic, and activity mixed together.

USAGE:
Often used in literary or descriptive writing to portray the noise and energy of cities, crowds, or events. Frequently appears in contrast with ⟦{静|しず}けさ→静けさ：14614_shizukesa⟧ (quietness) or ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧ (nature).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{喧騒|けんそう}: hustle and bustle of the city
- {喧騒|けんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧: to escape the noise/bustle
- {喧騒|けんそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be engulfed in noise
- {喧騒|けんそう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧: to flee from the commotion

WRITING:
Also written as ⟦{喧噪|けんそう}→喧噪：09054_kensou⟧. Both forms are standard, though {喧騒|けんそう} is more common in modern usage.
